name: Data-Driven Method for Li-Ion Battery Health Monitoring
description: Designed and implemented a machine learning framework using LSTM and GRU models to predict battery State-of-Health (SOH), addressing limitations of previous methods including high complexity, low interpretability, and high training costs. Achieved an average RMSE of 0.724% on real battery datasets. Awarded Gold at the Nanyang Research Programme (NRP) 2022.

name: Awesome Portfolio Page
description: A React portfolio template web application with data-driven configuration, enabling fully customisable portfolio sites to showcase professional experience, projects, and contact information. Features schema-validated JSON content management, ensuring seamless updates. Deployable to GitHub Pages, Netlify, and Vercel.

name: Intelligent System to Prevent Contamination of Recyclables
description: Built a YOLOv8-powered smart bin on Raspberry Pi for accurate waste classification, enabling recyclable vs. non-recyclable detection. Achieved 2nd runner-up at the Sustain-a-City Challenge, an urban innovation competition.

name: DSTA Today-I-Learned (TIL) AI Hackathon
description: Trained computer vision (CV) and natural language processing (NLP) models in PyTorch for robotic object detection and voice recognition, deployed on a robot to perform tasks with robust accuracy. Achieved 2nd runner-up at the DSTA TIL AI Competition.

name: HiMCM 2022 — Temperature and CO₂ Modelling
description: Modelled the global relationship between temperature and CO₂ using regression, time-series, and grey model analysis. Implemented the modelling pipeline in PyTorch and statistically compared the effectiveness of each approach. Earned a Merit Award in the High School Mathematical Contest in Modeling (HiMCM) 2022.
